name: Barcode
description: Generate EAN-13, UPC, Code 128, ITF-14, Data Matrix, PDF417 and more with automatic check digits, and read barcodes from images
help: For retail codes (EAN-13 / EAN-8 / UPC-A / ITF-14) you can type the digits without the check digit and it is calculated for you; a full number is verified, and a wrong check digit tells you the correct one.

Code 128 suits mixed letters and digits such as tracking or asset numbers. Code 39 only has capitals, digits and a few symbols; lowercase input uses Full ASCII mode, which some scanners must enable first.
Data Matrix, PDF417 and Aztec are 2D codes that hold longer text in any language. For QR codes use the QR Code tool.
SVG scales without loss and suits print; PNG size depends on pixels per module. Keep the blank quiet zone on both sides when printing.
On the Scan page, pick or drop an image or read a screenshot from the clipboard; every barcode and QR code in the image is read.

hints.upcA: North American retail code: 11 digits, check digit added
hints.itf: Shipping cartons: an even number of digits; 13 digits become ITF-14 with a check digit
hints.code128: Letters, digits and common symbols; the most common general-purpose barcode
hints.code93: More compact than Code 39, all ASCII characters
hints.codabar: Digits and - $ : / . +, optionally wrapped in A–D start/stop letters
hints.dataMatrix: 2D code, tiny; used on electronic parts and medicine
hints.pdf417: 2D code used on ID cards, boarding passes and waybills
hints.aztec: 2D code used on train tickets and boarding passes
